name: etf-analysis
description: AI-driven ETF and fund analysis engine. Handles three fund types: CLOSED_END (NAV premium, private holdings), THEMATIC_ETF (holdings alignment, expense drag, overlap), and CASH_FUND (yield, dividend timing). Saves structured JSON to data/etf_analysis/ and updates agentRationale in target-portfolio.json.
author: InvestmentToolkit

external_dependencies.name: fetch_fund_data.py
external_dependencies.purpose: Fetches fund metadata, NAV, and holdings from yfinance

external_dependencies.name: persist_etf_analysis.py
external_dependencies.purpose: Saves ETF analysis JSON to data/etf_analysis/ with versioning
